candidateScope: Legacy lip-tint composition correction only; extra spatial colour and outer-edge transition were withdrawn after independent visual review.

priorFailureEvidence.classification: The fixed 10% old-feather sampling premise failed before either skin-layer perturbation was executed; this was not a measured skin response failure.
priorFailureEvidence.cleanup: The original 15-second browser close also timed out after pending native renders; cleanup now explicitly drains each page before closing it, with bounded failure handling.

priorParameterSamplingFailureEvidence.classification: regionalColor had nonzero responses but did not meet four responses in the old lipColor positive-control subset. That subset did not establish regionalColor observability; its own published-R01 positive control now runs before candidate startup.

priorRegionalObservabilityFailureEvidenc.classification: The published R01 baseline itself had fewer than eight visible regionalColor responses in the thin old-feather intersection. This was a preflight observability failure, not a candidate pass or failure; quantitative preservation in that intersection is not claimed by this scoped suite.

skinResponseScope.beardShadow: Nonzero responses in the unchanged native near-mouth skin band and its independently selected R01 old-tint-positive old-feather overlap.
skinResponseScope.regionalColor: Nonzero responses in the unchanged native near-mouth skin band and at its independently visible published-R01 regionalColor positive-control pixels.

limitations: One frozen person, neutral pose, three existing views, one real Chromium SwiftShader runner.
Native LipRails projected ROI is a conservative mouth rectangle, not a pixel-perfect anatomical segmentation.
The retained R01 path is checked against one macro base-colour frame from the byte-identical published R01 page; the remaining views compare paths in the same candidate.
Near-mouth probes use projected native skin vertices 1.5–7 mm outside the outer lip rails in the inherited rest frame; no physiological measurement is claimed.

beardShadow uses the R01 lipColor-positive old-feather overlap. regionalColor uses its own visible positive control across the unchanged native near-mouth band in the byte-identical published R01 page, without an old-feather restriction. Neither set is selected from candidate responses.

regionalColor preservation in the thin old-feather intersection is not quantified: the original baseline had only four visible one-DN responses there. Skin checks establish nonzero observable responses, not exact preservation of their full magnitude.
The tests establish composition and preservation properties, not photorealism or user aesthetic approval.
The inherited remote loader is retained; offline operation and real-phone performance are not certified.
